proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Kalasha ric̣ excrement and Khowar ric̣(h) fresh dung of humans and animals under the combined *rikṣa or *rikṣya head. Trail and Cooper confirm the Urtsun variant iric̣; Bashir includes human feces. The link retains the unresolved reconstruction alternative already present in this public head.
